free_tier.stated: MiMo-V2.5-TTS Series is 'PriceFree (limited time)'; other models bill per million tokens (e.g. MiMo-V2.5 input cache-miss USD 0.14, output USD 0.28).

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

tooling: OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible clients against the MiMo endpoint
chaining: only TTS is free and only for a limited time; text models are paid

limits.value: TTS free for a limited time; text models per-token priced

identity_cost.detail: an account and API key from the MiMo platform; signup fields not detailed

reliability_note: model IDs MiMo-V2.5-Pro and MiMo-V2.5 are marked deprecated in the model catalogue; use V2.6

evidence.proved: the TTS series is free for a limited time

notes: The free text-model allowance is absent; only a limited-time TTS free price is documented. A MiMo Claw promo extends 'free usage' from 1h to 4h/day for that product, not the API.
